title: Took FOREVER to assemble!
text:
Took FOREVER to assemble!. These bar stools took forever to assemble. It was a nightmare for my husband to put them together. Honestly, they weren’t worth the hassle.
We are currently using them in our kitchen. They have a basic comfort level and durability. We have laminate floors in our kitchen apartment and these bar stools leave black marks on the floors. It’s easy to clean off, but annoying nonetheless.

product_metadata.title: KATDANS Counter Height Stools-24 Inch Bar Chair PU Leather, Bar Stools Set of 2 with Back and Arms-Kitchen Stools for Kitchen, Living Room, Pub, Bistro, Dark Brown, KS210303DB
features: Stylish: Embrace the comfort and simplicity of modern contemporary design with our bar chair. The sturdy metal base is fitted with a footrest and supports a seat upholstered in rich faux leather with arms and back. The perfect pick for any modern farmhouse-inspired space.

Sturdy Metal Base: Rather than other wood base barstools which might be vulnerable and wobbling. These metal base stools are built to last and avoid splitting or cracking during frequent use.
Dimensions: 19.75”(L) x 20”(W) x 33.75”(H) Seat Height 24". Bearing capacity: 300 lbs
